## Amplification

diag = |(L^{-1})_{rr}| = 1/|L_rr|; row-sum = sum_c |(L^{-1})_{rc}| (worst case for |dH_nu| <= delta, all nu);
the row-sum for I_r uses only the first r+1 coefficients, so it is the same for every n >= r+1.
